quantization.resident_memory_scope: All prepared quantized copies stay resident, including currently inactive weights. Screening memory is not fresh-deployment memory.
quantization.submission_counter_note: Counts Python kernel submissions during warmup/preparation/capture. CUDA graph replays do not reenter Python and do not increment these counters.
quantization.stream_contract: serial execution on one stream; shared quantization scratch

latency.boundary: GPU-ready input -> original full CUDA graph -> GPU synchronized; staging/download excluded
